info.name: Qlik Sense Enterprise Qlik Sense Service About Notification API
Qlik Sense Enterprise Subscribe to change notifications

params.name: Xrfkey
params.description: Cross-site request forgery prevention key. Must be 16 arbitrary characters matching the X-Qlik-Xrfkey header value.

items.docs: Creates a subscription to receive notifications when changes occur to specified entity types or individual entities.

info.name: Qlik Sense Enterprise Remove change notification subscription

params.name: Xrfkey
params.description: Cross-site request forgery prevention key. Must be 16 arbitrary characters matching the X-Qlik-Xrfkey header value.

params.name: handle
params.description: Handle identifying the notification subscription to remove

items.docs: Removes an existing notification subscription. The subscription handle is passed as a query parameter.

info.name: Qlik Sense Enterprise Get changes since last check

params.name: Xrfkey
params.description: Cross-site request forgery prevention key. Must be 16 arbitrary characters matching the X-Qlik-Xrfkey header value.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of changes that have occurred since the last time this endpoint was called for the given subscription.
